name: Do HOAs restrict ADUs and JADUs?

mainEntity.name: Do HOAs restrict ADUs and JADUs?

acceptedAnswer.text: State law requires HOAs to allow ADUs that meet local zoning and building codes; they cannot outright prohibit them but may have reasonable design standards.
